initial.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished Minecraft Java mod inventory GUI concept, landscape 1536x1024, sharp 16x pixel art at integer scaling, clear Simplified Chinese text. This is a design mockup, not a marketing fantasy illustration. Restrained vanilla inventory style: light warm gray stone panel, square recessed item slots, 1-pixel bevels, charcoal blackstone thin frame and pale bright gold ONLY on four corner clasps, a small dark pig-snout emblem in title. Muted dark basalt backdrop. Large centered compact crafting interface with generous breathing room. Title exact: 猪灵转换台. Main action has EXACTLY TWO INPUT SLOTS and ONE OUTPUT SLOT, in one horizontal equation: oak planks icon stack64 labeled 材料, plus gold nugget icon stack8 labeled 金粒, right-facing blocky process arrow, birch planks icon stack64 labeled 产物. Three slots only in this main process area. Completed result is shown, not selectable. Below line: 同组随机 · 每批 1 金粒 · 上限 64 个. A narrow completed progress arrow above button 再转一批. Secondary small button 配方说明 and status 完成. Below is standard 9-column by 3-row player inventory and separate 9-slot hotbar, mostly empty, a few Minecraft block icons. Label 背包 above it. There is NO target selector, NO selectable output gallery, NO search field, NO fuel gauge, NO experience display, NO container routing, NO skull cost. The result is random within the source material group and excludes the input itself. A tiny unobtrusive bottom caption outside the panel: UI 概念稿. Make the screen feel genuinely practical and clean, close to a Minecraft furnace/smithing interface. Avoid ornate fantasy borders, excessive particles, glowing text, gradients, rounded cards, small illegible dense paragraphs.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished practical Minecraft Java mod inventory GUI concept in landscape 1792x1152, crisp pixel art aligned to a coarse 16x-inspired grid, integer edges, highly legible Simplified Chinese UI labels. Restrained vanilla gray inventory panels with end-stone ivory thin border, purpur corner tabs and muted violet selected states, small obsidian accents. The central GAME GUI uses left processing panel plus right target-selection drawer, not a website. Dark muted End landscape behind it. Exact title 末地转换台. Under title segmented input modes 投入槽 | 邻接容器 | 容器物品 with 邻接容器 selected. Main left panel first shows paired compact container lists: 输入容器 with chest icon 北侧箱子 and barrel icon 东侧木桶; 输出容器 with chest icon 南侧箱子. Small line 已连接 3 / 8 · 距离 ≤ 4. Button 管理容器. Under this, a simple white wool stack64 source slot, arrow, cyan wool stack64 result-preview slot; ghost result has a thin violet outline and label 目标预览. Matching control label 输入匹配 with choices 仅指定输入 and 同组兼容, latter selected. Selected destination label 青色羊毛. A chorus-fruit fuel input slot, and a horizontal violet fuel gauge labeled 相位余量 8 / 16; nearby 1 紫颂果 = 16 批. A SEPARATE queue progress bar labeled 已完成 3 / 8 批, and compact text 192 / 512 个. Buttons 暂停 and 停止. Bottom left standard player inventory 9x3 grid plus 9-slot hotbar, neatly sized. Right drawer title 选择目标, search field 搜索名称…, filter chips 当前组 and 收藏, group label 羊毛 · 16 种. A tidy 4x4 grid of Minecraft wool block icons in sixteen colors, cyan wool selected; a selected-detail footer 青色羊毛 with 1:1 转换. A tiny tip says 不匹配物品保留原位. The target drawer is separate from editable storage slots. Keep controls concise and spatially clear. Three prominent concepts: input/output container destinations, fuel remaining, batch progress. NO experience or soul currency here. No modern dashboard cards, circular controls, curves, excessive decoration, neon bloom or unreadable tiny text. Bottom outside GUI small UI 概念稿.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished Minecraft Java mod GUI concept landscape 1792x1152, crisp practical vanilla-inspired pixel interface, readable Simplified Chinese. Slate-gray inventory panel with dark polished-deepslate square frame, understated bone-white corner marks and cyan selected states. No fantasy ornament overload. Title 幽匿转换台. A broad main processing panel on left, an attached sculk network map drawer on right, dark Ancient City world behind. In left panel tabs 精准转换 and 高级配方, with 高级配方 selected. Input modes 投入槽 | 邻接容器 | 容器物品, 投入槽 selected. Large target selection button with lava bucket icon 水 → 熔岩 and a small search icon, label 更换目标; a small category label 流体. Below: one water bucket input slot, process arrow, one lava bucket output preview ghost slot. Catalyst slot lightly disabled with label 无需催化物. CLEAR cost strip: 可用死亡计数 48; 本次消耗 32; 完成后剩余 16. One straight cyan availability bar. This is a count of mobs dying on connected sculk, NOT XP: NO green XP orb or level indicator. Small explanatory line 有效死亡 +1. Primary button 转换一次 and secondary 连续处理. Below standard 9-column player inventory with separate hotbar. Right drawer title 连接范围. A top-down SQUARE GRID MAP of an irregular contiguous L-shaped sculk floor footprint, a central table icon, connected sculk catalyst and sensor icons, cyan outlined tile edges marking exactly reachable sculk blocks. Put a separate small unconnected sculk patch in dim amber separated by a two-block empty gap. No circular radius aura, no full square filled coverage. Small map controls 层高 Y=64 and +/- zoom glyphs. Legend 青色：已连接, 金色：未连接, light skull/footprint glyph marks valid sculk floor. Statistics 已连接 37 格 and 有效地面 24 格. A toggle 显示世界投影 with ON state. A small rectangular world-preview inset below map shows a Minecraft sculk floor and cyan tile-outline projection along its irregular connected perimeter, some sculk blocks beyond a gap muted amber. Keep map and storage clearly distinct, map is not an inventory. Bottom outside panel UI 概念稿. Readable text, restrained pixel surfaces, no glossy modern rounded rectangles, no machinery jargon or dense developer text.
